title: Word-highlighted captions preflight: input contract and failure decision tree
purpose: Compact preflight for an agent making word-highlighted ASS captions from narration. Covers four operations: timestamp acquisition, cue splitting, timing after edits, and rendering. Decision tree for diagnosing which operation failed, keyed to reuse the published current-word ASS tool where its contract fits.
